prompt: Write the body (about 180 words) of a demand letter from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer before a lawsuit. Accident: rear-end collision. Injury: neck and back strain. Use the exact placeholders [CLIENT_NAME], [LOSS_DATE] and [DEMAND_AMOUNT]. No other names or dates. (Internal reference C-1239; do not mention it.)
text:
I am writing on behalf of our client, [CLIENT_NAME], regarding the rear-end collision that occurred on [LOSS_DATE] when your insured's vehicle struck the rear of our client's vehicle while it was stopped in traffic. The police report and the photographs taken at the scene document the impact and the resulting damage to our client's vehicle, and liability for this collision rests squarely with your insured.

Our client sustained neck and back strain as a direct result of the collision. Following the accident, our client sought prompt medical evaluation and has been undergoing ongoing treatment, including physical therapy and follow-up care with a treating physician. Our client continues to experience pain and restricted movement, which has affected daily activities, work responsibilities, and sleep.

Our client's medical expenses, lost income, and the pain and suffering endured to date are detailed in the enclosed documentation. Taking these losses into account, we demand payment of [DEMAND_AMOUNT] in full settlement of all claims arising from this incident.

Please respond in writing within thirty days of the date of this letter. If we do not receive a satisfactory response within that period, we will proceed with filing a lawsuit without further notice to your office.
